expectedIssues: Middle card in the carousel is not aligned with the other cards
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the cards are not aligned on a common baseline: the Green Bowl Poké image starts higher and is shorter, Smash Bros Burgers is pushed down, and titles/delivery fees sit at three different vertical positions.
The Green Bowl Poké thumbnail renders on a light grey/washed-out background while the neighbouring cards use dark full-bleed food photography, making it look like a broken or placeholder image.
The ETA badges ('15–25 min', '20–30 min') are placed at different vertical offsets within each card image and one badge overlaps the very bottom edge of its image.
Favorite heart buttons are styled inconsistently: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a plain white outline heart with no background, while the card below uses a dark circular button.
Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€0 delivery' both as an image badge and again in the metadata row, duplicating the same information.
